Inclusion Criteria 

CLSU Status

There are seven key criteria for universities to be included in the Rankings:

1. They are required to publish more than 1,000 relevant (Scopus indexed) publications over the previous 5 years, and more than 100 relevant (Scopus indexed) publications in any single year. This criterion was based on the publication count including kilo-authored fractional counting until the rankings published in 2023, when we changed to the full publication count.

Complied

3. They must not be focused on a single narrow subject area (more than 80% of their publication output is from one subject area).

Complied

4. They must have supplied “overall” numbers for the ranking year.

Complied

5. They must not have more than two of the critical values (academic staff, international academic staff, research staff, students, international students, undergraduate degrees awarded, doctorates awarded, institutional income, research income, research income from industry and commerce) as empty, unavailable, or withheld. Missing values will cause any metric based on that value to also be invalid.

Complied

6. They must mark at least one subject as applicable. If no applicable subjects have been reported the institution is excluded.

Complied
